title: Which Genshin Impact Vision would you get? Genshin character quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Genshin Impact quiz: answer 12 questions to find the Vision (Anemo, Geo, Electro, Dendro, Hydro, Pyro or Cryo) that matches your ideals, and the Genshin characters who share it. No sign-up.
h1: Which Genshin Impact Vision would you get?
lede: In Teyvat, the gods grant Visions to people with great ambition. Answer 12 questions about what you value and how you act, and find out which of the seven elements would choose you.
about: Each of Teyvat's seven nations follows an Archon and an ideal: freedom in Mondstadt (Anemo), contracts in Liyue (Geo), eternity in Inazuma (Electro), wisdom in Sumeru (Dendro), justice in Fontaine (Hydro), war and courage in Natlan (Pyro) and love in Snezhnaya (Cryo). This quiz matches your answers to those ideals.

Your result names your element, the ideal behind it and three playable characters who share it, with your scores for all seven. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by HoYoverse; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: What is a Vision in Genshin Impact?
faq.a: A Vision is a gem that lets its holder channel one element. The game says the gods grant them to people with great ambition or desire.
Your result lists three characters with the same element, for example Venti, Kaedehara Kazuha and Sucrose for Anemo. Pick the one whose story feels closest to yours.

faq.q: Why is there no Traveler result?
faq.a: The Traveler can use several elements without a Vision, so the quiz scores the seven elements instead.

anemo.name: Anemo: the ideal of freedom
anemo.body: You follow the wind. You value freedom above almost everything, hate being tied down and bring a light, playful energy that lifts the people around you. Anemo characters: Venti, Kaedehara Kazuha and Sucrose.

geo.name: Geo: the ideal of contracts
geo.body: Solid as stone. Your word is your bond, you plan for the long run and people trust you with what matters most. Geo characters: Zhongli, Navia and Noelle.

electro.name: Electro: the ideal of eternity
electro.body: Resolute and exacting. Once you decide on something you see it through, and you want what you build to last forever. Electro characters: Raiden Shogun, Fischl and Yae Miko.

dendro.name: Dendro: the ideal of wisdom
dendro.body: Curious and thoughtful. You want to understand how things really work, you read everything and your patience grows into real insight. Dendro characters: Nahida, Tighnari and Alhaitham.

hydro.name: Hydro: the ideal of justice
hydro.body: Expressive and principled. You care deeply about fairness, feel things strongly and are not afraid of a dramatic moment when it is deserved. Hydro characters: Furina, Neuvillette and Xingqiu.

pyro.name: Pyro: the ideal of war and courage
pyro.body: Brave and warm-hearted. You charge in to protect your friends, light up every celebration and never back down from a fight that matters. Pyro characters: Hu Tao, Diluc and Bennett.

cryo.name: Cryo: the ideal of love
cryo.body: Cool on the surface, devoted underneath. You love quietly and loyally, make sacrifices nobody sees and carry yourself with grace. Cryo characters: Ganyu, Kamisato Ayaka and Wriothesley.
